title: quercus dumosa var. turbinella
intro: Quercus dumosa var. turbinella, commonly known as the Turbinella oak, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the beech family (Fagaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Quercus dumosa var. turbinella include treating fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, as well as being used as a traditional remedy for various skin conditions. Its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
